scope.transport: normal F018B through the shared c2_dma_list and $D700

required_order: ELF-derived reader inventory with hot/cold attribution
execute the exact compiled Link-75 Lisp resolver against exact C2D and D81 host-side
post-symname-return hold first in the next otherwise-required hardware session
DMA single/paired/mixed measurement in the same session regardless of the post-symname result
require/defstruct retry only after the DMA outcome is classified or its attributed fix is qualified
fix-form review only after the first applicable discriminator has classified the mechanism

temperature_policy.hot: symfn_get/dir_find and any per-call function-cell lookup may not acquire per-access CRC or frame-scale polling
temperature_policy.warm: symval_get and GC/evaluator consumers require a bounded amortized form
temperature_policy.cold: name and nameoff readers may use content-defined retry if outcome A requires it

measurement.diagnostic_artifact_delta: stage 0 is a size-neutral patch; stage 1 is diagnostic-only and must pass its own slice/aggregate capacity gate; promotable product delta remains zero

stage0.name: post-symname-return-hold
stage0.position: first diagnostic row of the next otherwise-required product hardware session
stage0.capture: sym_name_scratch immediately after symname returns and before renderer pointer/length consumption
stage0.patch: Link-75 feasibility: slot 47, JSR at $C46F, two-byte BRA self-loop at $C472, session offset $EB1C, bytes 85 04 -> 80 FE
stage0.lifecycle: capture three times, then discard the diagnostic variant

stage1.condition: unconditional before the next require retry: the exact host resolver performs 399 Prim-67 Bank-5 byte reads, so renderer exoneration cannot exonerate resolver transport
stage1.trigger_contract: invoke the diagnostic error-overlay through an arity failure of the already-interned primitive; no new symbol or literal root may be created
stage1.position: after stage0 adjudication in the same device appointment
stage1.single_lane: one submission followed by immediate and settled observations while c2_dma_list remains untouched
stage1.paired_lane: two immediately consecutive submissions of the same source into disjoint destinations through the same c2_dma_list

mixed_lane.precondition: C2J is CLEAR, no append/emitter owns phase scratch, and the diagnostic owns Bank-0 source/destination buffers plus [published_c2d_end,published_c2d_end+64) inside the uncommitted append-scratch span
mixed_lane.link75_geometry: published_c2d_end=33840 ($8430), 64-byte target ends at $8470, strictly below the $BD00 Region-1 floor
sequence: one actual %c2d-byte(0,0) Prim-67 read: Bank 5 -> Bank 0, expected $43
one 64-byte record-shaped seed with iteration-distinct contents: Bank 0 -> Bank 5 append scratch
after the seed submission returns, poison and lifetime-reuse its probe-owned 64-byte Bank-0 buffer, then read back: Bank 5 append scratch -> Bank 0
one two-byte canonical lisp_t value-cell read: Bank 5 -> Bank 0, expected the live lisp_t word
mixed_lane.safety: no published C2D byte, code byte, symbol cell, Service record or persistent counter is written; a successor must rederive the published end and exact-meet proof instead of inheriting $8430

reproducibility.reset: each batch reinitializes the Bank-0 buffers identically and replays the same deterministic 64-byte payload sequence derived from iteration and byte index
reproducibility.receipt: retain one 256-bit failure bitmap per checked mixed observation (Prim67, 64-byte roundtrip, 2-byte cell) and batch, the first failing substep/sample, and a hash of the complete ordered observations

classification.stable: all mixed failure bitmaps are zero
classification.deterministic: a nonzero failure signature, first failing substep and samples are byteidentical in all three batches
classification.intermittent: at least one mixed failure occurs but the three signatures are not byteidentical

stage1.source_oracle: read-only JTAG capture of the rebound Bank-5 source before and after the row
stage1.lifecycle: diagnostic session-overlay variant is discarded after capture

decision_rule.post_symname_scratch_correct: renderer consumption fault for the DIRMISS detail finding; continue DMA measurement independently for resolver transport
decision_rule.post_symname_scratch_damaged: continue with the DMA single/paired/mixed measurement
decision_rule.both_stable: no reproduction in the homogeneous lanes; the mixed lane remains independently authoritative
decision_rule.single_never_converges: read seam confirmed but discriminator insufficient; return to review
decision_rule.mixed_deterministic: same mixed boundary and observation fail in all three batches; ordering/descriptor discipline is the leading fix class, subject to attribution
decision_rule.mixed_intermittent: mixed failures vary by batch or iteration; content-defined completion/convergence is the leading fix class, subject to attribution
decision_rule.mixed_stable: the real-shape boundary sequence did not reproduce; no fix may be selected from this campaign
